title: nextflow-template samplesheet schema
description: Samplesheet columns for params.input, for --help and launch forms. At runtime each row is converted to the SamplesheetRow record type in subworkflows/local/input/check/main.nf.

sample.errorMessage: Sample name must be provided and cannot contain spaces

platform.errorMessage: platform must be one of: ont_r9, ont_r10, pacbio_hifi; leave it empty to take --platform

fastq.errorMessage: A long-read FASTQ must be provided and end with .fastq/.fq(.gz)
